project_type: Discord.js v14 bot với TypeScript, module-based architecture
build_system: TypeScript compiler (tsc) với assets copy script. Commands: npm run build copy assets/public/data folders
test_framework: None found - manual testing qua Discord bot interaction
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to compile TypeScript. 2. Check dist/ folder for compiled .js files. 3. Start bot with npm start. 4. Test commands in Discord server. 5. Check bot console logs for errors.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ folder is generated by tsc build. Not checked in (in .gitignore). Assets/public folders are copied to dist/ during build.
environment_constraints: PowerShell execution policy may block scripts (already noted in user messages). Bot runs on Node v24.21.0. Discord.js v14 with Components V2 (MessageFlags.IsComponentsV2). Never restart dev server on port 3000 if already running.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing module structure in src/modules/. Each module has entry_point.ts + metadata.json. Use Components V2 pattern (ContainerBuilder, not embeds). Register commands via SlashCommandBuilder. Use emojis from src/config/emojis.ts. Follow existing patterns from server-generator-module for AI integration.
key_patterns: 1. Modules auto-load from src/modules/ via ModuleLoader. 2. Commands use Components V2 Cards (ContainerBuilder) not old embeds. 3. AI via Groq SDK with keyRotator for API key rotation. 4. Modal interactions must defer/reply within 3 seconds. 5. Button customIds format: 'module:action:userId:extra'. 6. Use emojis from src/config/emojis.ts animated format. 7. Data stored in data/ folder as JSON or SQLite. 8. Event handlers registered in module initialize() method.
directory_structure: src/modules/ contains all feature modules (admin-module, ai-module, giveaway-module, server-generator-module, utility, etc). src/config/ has emojis.ts. src/utils/ has aiKeyRotator.ts, aiChatService.ts. src/core/ has ModuleLoader.ts. data/ folder has JSON config files like welcome-config.json, economy.db. dist/ is build output.
